title: Global workspace theory and IIT imply rampant panpsychism

statements.text: If having a global workspace suffices for consciousness, then memory systems and the internet would be conscious. A maximal $\Phi$ can be found for any information processing system, down to photodiodes and power grids. Both theories fail to separate conscious from nonconscious systems where common sense does.

sources.quote: If possession of a global workspace is sufficient for consciousness, then GWT, is rampantly panpsychist.
IIT is thereby, like GWT, hugely panpsychist.
